summary: Frontend-only test of employee Browse Menu empty-state variants (offline vs online-no-site). Verified against preview URL using timefix_emp@cravitoo.com. All 5 sub-tests passed: (1) Online + no-site user renders data-testid='no-vendors-empty-state' with correct heading 'No menu available yet' and body mentioning Cravitoo admin; (2) dispatching window 'offline' event flips display to data-testid='offline-empty-state' with heading 'Network is offline' and body about stable network; (3) dispatching 'online' event flips it back; (4) initial mount with navigator.onLine=false + aborted /api/vendors renders offline-empty-state; (5) no-vendors and offline empty-states are mutually exclusive as designed. Note: audit_emp_a@corpa.com and qa_employee@gatetest.com credentials from the review request returned 401 in this env (likely wiped/reseeded); timefix_emp@cravitoo.com worked and is a natural no-site employee suitable for this test.
